companion.title: Hi {name}! ❤️
companion.question: Aaj kaisa feel kar rahe ho?
companion.input_placeholder: Apne dil ki koi baat share karo...
companion.resp_great: Ye sun kar dil khush ho gaya! Aise hi smiling raho aur energetic raho. ❤️
companion.resp_tough: Main samajh sakta hu... kabhi kabhi din thoda heavy lagta hai. Tum akele nahi ho, main saath hu. Deep breath lo. ❤️
companion.resp_visit: Kitna accha laga ki tum milne aaye! Mujhe tumhari yaad aati rehti hai. Apna khayal rakhna. ❤️
companion.resp_custom: Tumhari baat dil ko chu gayi. Main hamesha tumhare saath hu. Keep smiling! ❤️

care.reaction_doing: Great! Time waste mat karo, abhi kar lo. ❤️
care.reaction_snooze: Theek hai, thodi der me fir yaad dilaunga. Take care! ❤️
